footer.blurb: End-to-end encrypted file sharing. Your files are encrypted on your own device, shared by re-sealing a key for one named person, and stored as ciphertext the server cannot read.
footer.promiseBrowser: Encrypted in your browser, before upload
footer.promiseNoKey: The server holds no key it can use to read your files

password.requirementHint: At least {min} characters, mixing at least {classes} of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, symbols. It must not contain your username or email.
password.tooShort: Use at least {min} characters ({length} so far).
password.tooLong: Use at most {max} characters ({length} so far).
password.usesAccountDetails: Do not build your password out of your username or email address.
password.tooFewClasses: Mix at least {classes} of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, symbols.

login.title: Sign In
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.
login.noToken: Login response did not contain an access token

passphrase.label: Encryption Passphrase
passphrase.tooShort: Use at least {min} characters ({length} so far).
passphrase.sameAsPassword: Use a different value from your login password.

weak.common: This passphrase is on the lists attackers try first. Try four or more random words.
weak.pattern: Repeated or sequential characters are guessed in seconds. Try four or more random words.
weak.account: Do not build the passphrase from your username or email. Try four or more random words.

register.title: Create Account
register.afterDeletion: Your previous account and its files were deleted. You can register again with the same username and email if you want them.
register.passphraseTooShort: Use a passphrase of at least {min} characters.
register.usernameCharacters: Use only letters, numbers, underscore, dot, and hyphen.
register.confirmMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
register.codeInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.
register.codeSent: If {email} is available, a code is on its way. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
register.codeSendFailed: Could not send the verification code
register.fixErrors: Some details still need fixing. See the messages above.
register.passphrasePlaceholder: At least {min} characters, different from your password
register.passphraseHint: This never leaves your browser. It unlocks your private key. If you lose both it and the private key file you are given next, your encrypted files cannot be recovered. That is why it stays longer than your login password.
register.saveKeyIntro: Your account is ready. This is your account's RSA private key — the key your files are encrypted to. It is shown once and is not stored anywhere in readable form on the server.
register.saveKeyWhy: {saveIt} It is the only way back into your files if you forget your encryption passphrase: with it you can set a new passphrase in Settings, and without it neither the team nor the server holds anything that can open your files. The download is a plain text {pem} file — your computer may have no application associated with it, which is expected; any text editor can open it.
register.saveKeySecret: Because it needs no passphrase, treat the file itself as the secret: anyone who holds it can decrypt your files. Keep it somewhere you would keep a password, not in your Downloads folder.
register.keyAcknowledge: I have saved this private key somewhere safe. I understand it will not be shown again, and that without it a forgotten passphrase means losing access to my files.
register.twoSecretsBody: Your login password lets you sign in, and the server checks it. Your encryption passphrase never leaves this browser: it locks the key that opens your files, so not even the server, or we, can read them. Use a different one, and keep it somewhere safe.

forgot.title: Reset Password
forgot.intro: Verify your account with your username and email, confirm the emailed code, then set a new password.
forgot.codeSent: If an account uses {email}, a code is on its way. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
forgot.loginOnly: This changes your login password only. Your encryption passphrase and private key are unaffected, so your encrypted files stay accessible.
forgot.done: Your password has been updated. Sign in with the new password.
forgot.revokedSessions: {n} other active session was signed out for safety. | {n} other active sessions were signed out for safety.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Applies immediately and is remembered on this device.
settings.languageHint: The language of the interface. Remembered on this device. File names, usernames and anything you write stay exactly as they are.
settings.deleteBody: Removes the account and every file uploaded from it. There is no way to reverse this and no way to recover the files afterwards. If you are locked out by a forgotten passphrase, reset it above with your saved private key file instead.
settings.fingerprintBody: When someone shares a file with you, their screen shows this fingerprint for your key. Reading it out to each other and checking it matches proves the file is sealed to you and not to a key someone substituted.
settings.fingerprintError: Your fingerprint could not be loaded. Sign in again and reopen Settings.
settings.passwordResetTitle: An administrator reset your login password
settings.passwordResetBody: You signed in with a temporary password that the administrator has seen. Set a password of your own in the Login password card below before you carry on. Your files and encryption passphrase are not affected.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.consequence: This deletes your account and every file you have uploaded, including files you have shared with other people. It cannot be undone, and no one — not the team, not the server — can bring the files back afterwards.
deleteAccount.unlockWithKey: unlocking with your private key file
deleteAccount.tryKeyFile: If you are here because you forgot your encryption passphrase, try {unlock} first: the {pem} you saved at registration opens your files without the passphrase. Deleting is only worth it if that file is gone too.
deleteAccount.needBoth: Enter your login password and type DELETE to confirm
deleteAccount.lastAdmin: You are the only active administrator, so this account cannot be deleted yet. Another administrator account has to be active first, or no one could reach the admin console afterwards.

changePassphrase.title: Change your encryption passphrase
changePassphrase.intro: If you still know your current passphrase, enter it here to choose a new one. Your files, your shares and your account key stay as they are; neither passphrase leaves this browser.
changePassphrase.same: The new passphrase must be different from the current one.
changePassphrase.wrongCurrent: That is not your current encryption passphrase. If you have forgotten it, use your private key file below.
changePassphrase.done: Your new passphrase is set and was checked against what the server now stores. The old one no longer works. Keep your private key file safe; it is still the way back if you forget this one.
changePassphrase.failed: The passphrase could not be changed

resetPassphrase.title: Forgot your encryption passphrase?
resetPassphrase.intro: Set a new one with the private key file you were given once at registration. Your files, your shares, and your account key stay exactly as they are; only the passphrase that unlocks the key changes. The file is read in this browser and is never uploaded.
resetPassphrase.done: Your new passphrase is set and was checked against what the server now stores. Keep your private key file somewhere safe; it is still the only way back if you forget this passphrase too.
resetPassphrase.newHint: At least {min} characters. Not your login password.
resetPassphrase.acknowledge: I understand my old encryption passphrase will stop working as soon as this completes. My files and shares are not affected.
resetPassphrase.slowOnPurpose: Deriving the new key takes a moment on purpose: the same cost that slows this down slows an attacker guessing the passphrase offline.
resetPassphrase.mismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
resetPassphrase.chooseFile: Choose the private key file you saved at registration.
resetPassphrase.needAcknowledge: Confirm that you understand the old passphrase will stop working.
resetPassphrase.wrongKey: That key file does not belong to this account. Check you saved it from this account.
resetPassphrase.failed: The passphrase could not be reset

errors.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_refresh_token: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.access_denied: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.password_change_required: Choose a new login password in Settings before you carry on.
errors.resource_not_found: That item could not be found.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.account_identifier_unavailable: That username is already taken. Choose another.
errors.last_admin: That would leave no active administrator. Another administrator has to be active first.
errors.invalid_input: Some of the details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.request_validation_failed: Some of the details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.weak_password: That password is too weak or too common. Choose a stronger one.
errors.invalid_verification_code: The verification code is wrong or has expired.
errors.verification_code_required: Enter the verification code sent to your email.
errors.email_delivery_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.file_not_found: That file could not be found. It may have been deleted, or access to it revoked.
errors.file_folder_not_found: That folder could not be found.
errors.file_folder_name_conflict: A folder with that name already exists.
errors.user_key_not_found: No account key was found for that user.
errors.key_protection_profile_not_found: No key protection settings were found for this account.
errors.recovery_request_not_found: That recovery request could not be found.
errors.key_bundle_revision_conflict: Your account key changed in another tab or device. Refresh and try again.
errors.key_protection_reset_unavailable: The passphrase cannot be reset for this account right now.
errors.invalid_key_bundle: The account key data is not valid.
errors.invalid_file_envelope: The encrypted file data is not valid.
errors.file_too_large: That file is too large to upload.
errors.file_state_conflict: That file has changed since the page loaded. Refresh and try again.
errors.share_state_conflict: That share has changed since the page loaded. Refresh and try again.
errors.recovery_state_conflict: That recovery request has changed since the page loaded. Refresh and try again.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.integrity_verification_failed: The file failed its integrity check: the stored copy does not match what was uploaded.
errors.auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.avatar_invalid: That picture is not a valid PNG or JPEG image.
errors.avatar_rate_limited: The picture was changed too often. Try again later.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
